messages:
sofia_cs: Quick sync — Evergreen week0: they can reach the control plane but KMS calls are 403 from our side. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/EVG-512

devon_neteng: Can you paste the error? 403 from aws_kms:AccessDenied usually means key policy or IAM role mismatch.

sofia_cs: Error snippet from app logs: `ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Encrypt operation` — they use an assumed role `arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/rdw-priv-role` to call KMS.

jordan_infra: Quick check: is the KMS key policy granting `sts:AssumeRole` -> no that's for roles. Key policy needs `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:Decrypt` for the principal ARN. Also ensure `kms:ViaService` is covered when calling through an endpoint.

alice_security: Sharing a minimal trust snippet they need to include in the key policy:

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodAssumedRole",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/rdw-priv-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

sofia_cs: thanks. I can push that to their infra team — also noticed they haven't enabled CloudTrail S3 aggregation into their SIEM. ops-bot, did we push the audit runbook to them?

ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.docs/privvpc/audit-forwarding — last sent 2026-03-12 to infra@evergreen.com :white_check_mark:

devon_neteng: network follow-up: customer NAT health is flaky. From our side, TLS handshakes to their endpoint sometimes time out. Asking them to check SNAT table size and ephemeral port exhaustion.

sofia_cs: I've flagged that with the account health score — dropping from 85 to 70 if unresolved. kevin_renewals, FYI renewal risk note.

kevin_renewals: noted — ping me if we move into >14-day unblock window. Could affect renewal offer if perf SLOs not met.

jordan_infra: plan: I will open a quick canary PK to verify after they update KMS policy. devon — can you coordinate a short packet capture window with them tomorrow 09:00-09:30 PDT?

devon_neteng: yep, I'll book 09:00 PDT, will add steps: `tcpdump -i eth0 port 443` and share capture S3 link.

sofia_cs: Also scheduling a 20-min enablement call to run through key policy + SIEM forwarding. Proposed slots: Thu 15:00 or Fri 10:00 PT. evergreen infra team prefers Thu. Confirmed.

alice_security: minor ask — request they rotate their KMS key alias to include `rdw-` prefix so our audit automation can detect it automatically. gives us better telemetry.

sofia_cs: will add to the action items. owners: KMS policy (evergreen infra), packet capture (evergreen infra + devon), enablement call (sofia_cs), renewal flag (kevin_renewals). I'll follow up post-call with a short retrospective and ask for a one-line NPS about the onboarding docs.

kevin_renewals: thanks — please loop in legal if they request contract changes because of key custody.

sofia_cs: ACK. Closing loop — will update ticket EVG-512 and post notes here after call :thumbsup:
